title: TikTok explores peer-to-peer payments via DMs, report says
summary: If rolled out, the feature would use the social media service’s TikTok Pay offering, which is already available in Southeast Asia for TikTok Shop purchases. By introducing peer-to-peer payments, TikTok would be competing with services like Venmo and Zelle.
